description: This PHP class file defines the tlHTMLTable class, which extends tlTable to generate HTML tables for documents and spreadsheets, including methods for rendering table sections, and specific renderers for status and priority columns.

classes.name: tlHTMLTable
classes.description: Helper class used to generate HTML tables, extending tlTable, with custom rendering methods for status and priority columns.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the table with columns, data, and configuration-dependent properties.

methods.name: renderCommonGlobals
methods.description: Stub method; does nothing. Actual rendering is handled in renderBodySection.

methods.name: renderHeadSection
methods.description: Stub method; does nothing. Actual rendering is handled in renderBodySection.

methods.name: renderBodySection
methods.description: Generates the HTML for the table body, rendering each row and handling special column types for priority and status.

methods.name: renderStatus
methods.description: Returns an HTML span with a CSS class and text for status items.

methods.name: renderPriority
methods.description: Returns the localized label for a given priority value.
